title: Quake 3 meets Descent with flying cars! 🚀🛸
author: oksowhaat
selftext:
I had to create this game. It brings back so much nostalgia for me, and I hope you all enjoy it as much as I do! 🕹️

Claude Fable 5 + Three.js = pure magic if you give fable the 3d assets folder. He creates the level design entirely. I did not expect it to be this good. 

The game has a fully functional multiplayer mode. Come hop in and shoot some Rails! 💥🎯

Play here: [https://sky-cruiser-9065b31330ea.herokuapp.com/](https://sky-cruiser-9065b31330ea.herokuapp.com/) 🌐

comments.author: SillyYou8433
comments.body:
This actually looks so awesome!! Did you create anything (models specifically?) or was it all fable? Thats way better 3d art than I've ever gotten it to do! Super impressed

I tried to play the demo but the buttons never changed from "Loading..."

replies.author: oksowhaat
replies.body:
I found a cheap low poly city assets on fab and dropped it to Fable. I did not even open a 3d software.  
the game is working the loading should be 30s to 1min unless ur internet is slow. The dist folder is just 14.5mb

comments.author: Illustrious-Lime-863
comments.body: Cool game. Got you a couple of times, in my head you totally didn't let me

replies.author: oksowhaat
replies.body: haha u didn't use the weapons. but not bad nevertheless :)

replies.author: Illustrious-Lime-863
replies.body: The default machine gun is pretty strong. The rocket was slow, can imagine it causes a lot of damage if it hits. Got the laser a couple of times I think I hit you a couple of times but found it run out quick. But yeah this is a cool game, well done. If you polish it up with some single player story and missions etc you could totally publish this on steam with MP

replies.author: oksowhaat
replies.body: Actually there is a single player mode (Outlaw Hunt) and 3 maps. Thank you for the feedback buddy apreciated

replies.body: It is smooth when you play, but it feels slow at the same time.. something has to be tweaked. Overall I think it looks great and works... I tried it in the browser on my desktop with the screen maximized.

replies.author: oksowhaat
replies.body: Hmm It's high fps on my browser. I will see what could be causing the issue. Thank you buddy apreciate your feedback.
